technology_name: Herbal Drug for Comprehensive Wellness: Multi-Therapeutic Single-Herb Formulation
institution: KSCSTE- Jawaharlal Nehru Tropical Botanic Garden & Research Institute (JNTBGRI)
problem_solved: The reliance on complex polyherbal mixtures or chemical-based synthetic drugs with potential side effects for managing pain, inflammation, and liver dysfunction.
description: A novel, patented single-herb formulation developed to deliver broad-spectrum therapeutic effects without synthetic additives. Rich in flavonoids and polyphenols, the composition acts simultaneously as an anti-inflammatory (inhibiting COX-2 and TNF-a), analgesic, hepatoprotective, and antioxidant agent. It is manufactured in two standardized, user-friendly formats: oral granules for systemic treatment and topical ointment for localized application, merging traditional medicinal wisdom with scientific validation.
applications:
• Commercial manufacturing of over-the-counter (OTC) phytopharmaceutical products

• Alternative medicine and holistic healthcare treatment therapies

• Production of natural, non-toxic topical ointments for localized pain relief

• Dietary and wellness supplements targeting liver health and oxidative stress
